HostUrl.title: Tenant Host URL
HostUrl.description: Per-tenant re:Members AMS (Impexium) raw REST host, e.g. https://abc.mpxapi.com. Confirmed Tier-1 (apiProperties.json 'hostUrl' connection parameter). Every API path is relative to this host with an /api/v1/ prefix.

AppId.title: App ID (candidate A -- unverified)
AppId.description: App-init identifier for the hypothesized app+user handshake against the raw host (strongest-evidence candidate, NOT confirmed by a live round-trip). Leave blank if the tenant instead uses the single API-key fallback (see ApiKey).

AppKey.title: App Key (candidate A -- unverified)
AppKey.description: App-init secret for the hypothesized app+user handshake. Presented alongside AppId + AppName (+ end-user login) to obtain an Access-Token/App-Token pair. Unverified -- see Configuration.AuthModel in the Integration record for the full evidence trail.

AppName.title: App Name (candidate A -- unverified)
AppName.description: App-init display name for the hypothesized app+user handshake.

UserEmail.title: User Email (candidate A -- unverified)
UserEmail.description: End-user login email presented during the app-init handshake, per candidate A. Only needed if the app+user model is confirmed live.

UserPassword.title: User Password (candidate A -- unverified)
UserPassword.description: End-user login password presented during the app-init handshake, per candidate A.

ApiKey.title: API Key (candidate B -- alternate/fallback surface)
ApiKey.description: Single x-api-key header value. Confirmed Tier-1 for the Microsoft-certified Power Platform connector's Azure APIM proxy layer only (apiDefinition.swagger.json securityDefinitions) -- NOT confirmed as the raw host's own auth scheme. Recorded as a cheaply swappable fallback per Configuration.AuthModel.resolution.
